// diagnostic

E0630

Teaching: an import uses the retired `as` alias or `.{…}` member list

What

Teaching: an import uses the retired `as` alias or `.{…}` member list

Why

An import's local name comes first, as `alias :: path`, and a member list is written in brackets

Fix

Write `alias :: path` for `path as alias`, give each renamed member its own `alias :: owner.member` row, and write `owner.[…]` for `owner.{…}`; `jet fmt` rewrites the import.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0630: tests/ui/module_brace_group.stderr.

Error [jet.RetiredImportAlias]: `.{…}` is not an import member list
  --> tests/ui/module_brace_group.jet:7:10
    |
  7 | use math.{double}
    |          ^
 Why: A member list is written in brackets, as `owner.[a, b]` (#6542)
 Fix: Write `use math.[…]`
